answer: All tests pass! The issue was in `/shopcart/pricing.py:14`. The `bulk_discount` function was checking `if qty > BULK_THRESHOLD:` when it should check `if qty >= BULK_THRESHOLD:` to apply the discount at the threshold (10 units) and above, not just above. The docstring states "when buying BULK_THRESHOLD units or more", confirming the discount should apply at the threshold.
